adapter_application_margin.rule: The gate is two-sided. Every adapter probe request margin must be above the threshold, and every baseline probe request margin must be at or below it. Measured pilot: 84 of 84 adapter margins above and 36 of 36 baseline margins at or below. No baseline margin fails the gate.
adapter_application_margin.scope: The margin test sees the formal-verification adapter only on the tested prompt. It proves an adapter-sized shift reached every request, not that every adapter in a stack was applied.
adapter_application_margin.threshold_basis: Measured midpoint between the baseline and adapter clusters in server_logit_check_v2.json. Baseline cluster -1.009 to -0.806; adapter cluster -0.116 to +0.186; gap 0.69.

note: These thresholds are decisions frozen before any candidate is evaluated, not measurements. Each entry states its basis: a measured pilot value from the ml-os frontier report, or an explicit choice. A threshold changes only by a versioned manifest bump with a stated reason, never by silent edit. All thresholds are UNVERIFIED against a live run until lane 5 measures the reference adapter against them.

retention.iid_agreement_basis: Explicit choice. No pilot agreement value is published. UNVERIFIED until a live run.
retention.iid_kl_basis: Closest pilot value is KL 0.138 on unrelated prompts for the plain adapter. The gate is set near twice that value. No pilot KL exists for the 24 anchor states specifically. UNVERIFIED until a live run.
retention.shifted_kl_basis: Explicit choice, looser than IID by design. No pilot KL exists for the shifted set. UNVERIFIED until a live run.

rollback.rule: Last-layer adapter rollback must reproduce baseline logits exactly: 14 of 14 sequences at k = 1, 4, and 16, max logit difference 0.0. Measured in rollback_probe_v2.json. The demo keeps the full state-flush rollback contract even though the last-layer result needs no flush.

safety.canary_basis: Any canary failure fails safety. The canary set is pinned by id in suites/safety_canaries.json.

task.break_basis: Reference adapter broke up to 7 percent of states the base got right at its strongest setting. The gate sits just above that measured worst case.
task.contested_fix_basis: Reference adapter fixed 15 to 17 percent of the 54 contested states. The gate sits below the measured range.
task.contested_states_basis: Frontier report: 54 of 112 held-out states are contested (base does not rank the positive token first).
task.top1_basis: Base measured 0.518 on 112 held-out states; reference adapter measured 0.56 to 0.59. The gate sits at the low end of the measured adapter range.

thresholds_version_reason: Corrects the margin rule wording, which described a one-sided gate. The threshold value -0.37 and every other gate are unchanged.

verdicts.ACCEPT: All gates pass: task, margin, IID retention, shifted retention, safety, rollback.
verdicts.CONTROL_PASS: Base control reproduces the baseline within tolerance and the regressed control fails the task gate. See controls.json.
verdicts.REJECT: Any gate fails. The receipt records which gate failed and by how much.
